question: Subtracting 1% of X from X is the same as multiplying X by:
solution:
**Given:**

X - (1% of X)

**Formula Used:**

1% of X = (1 ÷ 100) × X

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1% of X = (1 ÷ 100) × X = 0.01 × X

⇒ X - (1% of X) = X - 0.01 × X

⇒ X × (1 - 0.01) = X × 0.99

**∴ The final expression simplifies to X × 0.99.**
